name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land
description: PM-KISAN provides direct income support to eligible farmer families across India.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefits: Insurance coverage for crop loss due to natural disasters
description: Provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage.

name: Kisan Credit Card
eligibility: Farmers, fishermen, and animal husbandry farmers
benefits: Short-term credit support for farming activities
description: KCC provides affordable loans to farmers for agriculture and allied activities.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefits: Free soil testing and crop nutrient recommendations
description: Helps farmers improve productivity through soil analysis.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
benefits: Financial assistance and training for organic farming
description: Promotes cluster-based organic farming and sustainable agriculture.
